items.docs:
Return the latest block available to the backends, also known as the
tip of the blockchain.

params.name: count
params.description: The number of results displayed on one page.

params.name: page
params.description: The page number for listing the results.

params.name: order
params.description:
Ordered by tx index in the block.
The ordering of items from the point of view of the blockchain,
not the page listing itself. By default, we return oldest first, newest last.

items.docs: Return the transactions within the latest block.
